description: Capabilities for the voice-orb window (the SiriGL waveform/canvas shown while the global voice hotkey is recording). The window is shown/hidden via the custom voice_orb_hide invoke command (the show side is driven directly from Rust in voice_start, bypassing the ACL). The orb only needs event access: listen for voice://mic-level (live RMS feed from the Rust recorder) and voice://orb-phase (phase/trigger broadcast from the main window's useVoiceInput store — Tauri windows are separate JS realms, so the store does NOT sync across windows).
